15467-the-first-soprano.title: The First Soprano
15467-the-first-soprano.creator: Mary Hitchcock
15467-the-first-soprano.description: A book by Mary Hitchcock. Clear, pure and true, the sweet voice floated through the church. With dramatic sympathy it yielded to the spirit of the melody and the pathos of the words. It touched hearts with a sense of undefined sorrow and longing. Madame Chapeau, the French milliner, who rented a sitting in the church of her patrons, sat with eyes filled with tears that threatened to plough pale furrows through the roses of her cheeks.

arxiv-1901-11277.creator: Dhruba Jyoti Gogoi, Umananda Dev Goswami
arxiv-1901-11277.description: Abstract We investigate the different polarization modes of Gravitational Waves (GWs) in f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) gravity power law model in de Sitter space. It is seen that the massive scalar field polarization mode exists in this model. The mass of the scalar field depends highly on the background curvature and the power term n n .

arxiv-2011-06199.title: Analysis on Lambert-Tsallis functions
arxiv-2011-06199.creator: Hideto Nakashima, Piotr Graczyk
arxiv-2011-06199.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study the Lambert-Tsallis W W function, which is a generalization of the Lambert W W function with two real parameters. We give a condition on the parameters such that there exists a complex domain touching zero on boundary which is mapped bijectively to the upper half plane by the Lambert-Tsallis function.

arxiv-2104-13257.title: Early Classification of Time Series is Meaningful
arxiv-2104-13257.creator: Youssef Achenchabe, Alexis Bondu, Antoine Cornuéjols, and Vincent Lemaire
arxiv-2104-13257.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Youssef Achenchabe, Alexis Bondu, Antoine Cornuéjols, and Vincent Lemaire. Many approaches have been proposed for early classification of time series in light of its significance in a wide range of applications including healthcare, transportation and finance. However, recently a preprint saved on Arxiv claims that all research done for almost 20 years now on the Early Classification of Time Series is useless, or, at the very least, ill-oriented because severely lacking a strong ground.

arxiv-2105-11449.title: The hunt for sub-solar primordial black holes in low mass ratio binaries is open
arxiv-2105-11449.creator: Khun Sang Phukon, Gregory Baltus, Sarah Caudill, Sebastien Clesse, Antoine Depasse, Maxime Fays, Heather Fong, Shasvath J. Kapadia, Ryan Magee, Andres Jorge Tanasijczuk

Kapadia, Ryan Magee, Andres Jorge Tanasijczuk. We perform a search for binary black hole mergers with one subsolar mass black hole and a primary component above 2 ​ M ⊙ 2M_{\odot} in the second observing run of LIGO/Virgo.

arxiv-2205-03467.title: EVIMO2: An Event Camera Dataset for Motion Segmentation, Optical Flow, Structure from Motion, and Visual Inertial Odometry in Indoor Scenes with Monocular or Stereo Algorithms
arxiv-2205-03467.creator: Levi Burner, Anton Mitrokhin, Cornelia Fermüller, Yiannis Aloimonos
arxiv-2205-03467.description: Abstract A new event camera dataset, EVIMO2, is introduced that improves on the popular EVIMO dataset by providing more data, from better cameras, in more complex scenarios. As with its predecessor, EVIMO2 provides labels in the form of per-pixel ground truth depth and segmentation as well as camera and object poses.

arxiv-2211-02207.title: Evidence for episodic and patchy mass ejection in the circumstellar envelope of AGB star R Leonis 2022 Evidence for episodic and patchy mass ejection in the circumstellar envelope of AGB star R Leonis – References

The morpho-kinematics of the circumstellar envelope of oxygen-rich AGB star R Leonis is probed using ALMA (Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array) observations of the emission of molecular lines, including in particular CO(2-1) and 29 SiO(5-4).

arxiv-2502-09173.title: Two-Stage Representation Learning for Analyzing Movement Behavior Dynamics in People Living with Dementia
arxiv-2502-09173.creator: Jin Cui, Alexander Capstick, Payam Barnaghi, Gregory Scott
arxiv-2502-09173.description: Abstract In remote healthcare monitoring, time series representation learning reveals critical patient behavior patterns from high-frequency data. This study analyzes home activity data from individuals living with dementia by proposing a two-stage, self-supervised learning approach tailored to uncover low-rank structures. The first stage converts time-series activities into text sequences encoded by a pre-trained language model, providing a rich, high-dimensional representation.

pmc-10477135.title: Butterfly gliomas: a time for stratified management?
pmc-10477135.creator: Siddharth Sinha, Adam Avnon, Andrea Perera, Jose Pedro Lavrador, Keyoumars Ashkan
pmc-10477135.description: Butterfly glioblastomas (bGBM) are a rare subset of WHO grade IV tumours that carry a poor prognosis with a median survival ranging between 3.3 to 6 months. Given their poor prognosis, there is debate over whether histological diagnosis with a biopsy or any surgical or oncological intervention alters disease progression.

pmc-10732681.title: Genome-wide expression analysis of LBD genes in tomato (Solanum lycopersicum L.) under different light conditions
pmc-10732681.creator: Limei Dong, Hakim Manghwar
pmc-10732681.description: Lateral organ boundaries (LOB) domain (LBD) genes, a gene family that encodes the transcription factors (TFs) of plants, plays crucial functions in the development and growth of plants. Currently, genome-wide studies of the LBD family are still limited to tomato (Solanum lycopersicum L.), which is considered an important economic crop.

pmc-11314433.title: Healthy Sleep Pattern, Metabolic Diseases, and Risk of Stroke: The Kailuan Cohort Study
pmc-11314433.creator: Lili Huang, Yesong Liu, Tingting Geng, Nannan Zhang, Liang Sun, Shouling Wu, Xiang Gao
pmc-11314433.description: BackgroundSleep complaints were reported to be associated with stroke, however, the evidence on the association between healthy sleep pattern and stroke risk in Chinese is limited.ObjectiveThe aim of this study was to investigate the association between healthy sleep pattern and stroke in Chinese, and the influence of metabolic diseases on the association.

pmc-11491970.title: Understanding the emergence of highly pathogenic avian influenza A virus H5N1 in pinnipeds: An evolutionary approach
pmc-11491970.creator: Mercedes Paz, Valentina Franco-Trecu, Diana Szteren, Alicia Costábile, Cecilia Portela, Alfredo Bruno, Gonzalo Moratorio, Pilar Moreno, Juan Cristina
pmc-11491970.description: Highlights•Avian influenza virus (AIV) spread to pinnipeds caused a remarkable mortality.•Phylogenetic analyses of AIV strains isolated from pinniped species was performed.•AIV strains isolated from pinnipeds bear characteristics of a highly pathogenic form.•Different evolutionary histories of different influenza virus genes were observed.•Amino acid substitutions that confer advantages for infecting mammals were found.

pmc-11666916.title: Protective Effects of Polysaccharides From Sargassum hemiphyllum (Turner) C. Agardh Against Alcohol‐Induced LO2 Cell Damage
pmc-11666916.creator: Yuxuan Liang, Zhuo Wang, Rui Li, Saiyi Zhong, Xiaofei Liu, Jianping Chen
pmc-11666916.description: The study aimed to explore the protective impact of polysaccharide derived from Sargassum hemiphyllum (Turner) C. Agardh (SHP) against ethanol‐induced injury in LO2 hepatocytes, along with its potential mechanism of action. A model of alcoholic injury in LO2 cells was established to assess the shielding effect of SHP against liver injury induced by alcohol.

pmc-12566077.title: Trends in the Antimicrobial Resistance Pattern of Bacterial Gram-Negative Pathogens in Elderly Patients Admitted to the Intensive Care Unit
pmc-12566077.creator: Andreea-Loredana Golli, Ovidiu Mircea Zlatian, Simona-Georgiana Popa, Flavia Liliana Turcu, Andrei Theodor Balasoiu, Benno H Ter Kuile
pmc-12566077.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) remains a public health problem in European Union countries, and elderly patients represent a vulnerable category due to aging and its associated risk factors. In this research, we investigated the trend of the antimicrobial resistance pattern of Gram-negative pathogens isolated in samples collected from elderly patients (over 65 years) hospitalized in the intensive care unit (ICU) between 2022 and 2024.

pmc-12635357.title: Differences in clinical features between current smokers and former smokers with OSA: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12635357.creator: Zhifeng Chen, Yulin Shang, Binaya Wasti, Yanru Ou, Subo Gong, Xudong Xiang, Ruoyun Ouyang
pmc-12635357.description: Smoking is both a cause of obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and is an important reason for its rising prevalence. However, there is a lack of studies predicting smoking cessation specifically in patients with OSA. This study aimed to identify the factors linked to smoking cessation by examining and comparing the clinical characteristics of current smokers and former smokers with OSA.

pmc-12690305.title: Acute cholecystitis in older adults with multimorbidity: does surgery offer better outcomes?
pmc-12690305.creator: Anaïs Tribolet, Sophie Chopinet
pmc-12690305.description: (ALC). This was a retrospective cohort study using Medicare administrative data, conducted in the United States between April 2016 and December 2018. The authors included patients aged 65.5 years or older. Multimorbidity was identified using validated comorbidity sets within the Medicare database.

pmc-12815278.title: Where Are We Going by Applying AI Tools? Are We Going to Lose Our Jobs?
pmc-12815278.creator: Antonio Mutti
pmc-12815278.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). s question has reached our editorial team not from a futuristic article, but from a concrete dialogue I had today with an autonomous AI agent. This experience has forced us to confront the future of our own work directly. Recently, I relied on one of these advanced systems on a task as traditional as it is complex: the scientific review of manuscripts submitted for publication. The experience went far beyond simple proofreading.

pmc-13005968.title: Building the Optometry Workforce in Somalia: A Strategic Approach to Preventing Avoidable Blindness and Expanding Access to Vision Care
pmc-13005968.creator: Abdullahi Abdirahman Omar, Abdulsalam Ahmed Mohamed
pmc-13005968.description: PurposeSomalia faces a substantial burden of avoidable eye disease, while access to primary eye-care services remains uneven and optometry training capacity is limited. This rapid communication reports the pattern of ocular conditions and service needs identified in a large service-based eye-care dataset from Mogadishu and outlines a practical implementation framework for strengthening the optometry workforce in Somalia.

pmc-13097736.title: Telehealth among Medicare Advantage beneficiaries with and without Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias (ADRD), 2018–2024: from pandemic-era surge to post-pandemic decline
pmc-13097736.creator: Hailemichael B. Shone, Sih-Ting Cai, Kosali Simon, Jennifer L. Carnahan, Malaz Boustani
pmc-13097736.description: BackgroundTelehealth has become a vital element of healthcare delivery, especially among Medicare Advantage (MA) beneficiaries. Yet its use among individuals with Alzheimer’s Disease and Related Dementias (ADRD) – a population with complex biopsychosocial needs – remains understudied. MethodsWe conducted an observational cohort study of MA beneficiaries aged 65 and older using Optum’s de-identified Clinformatics® Data Mart Database (January 2017–June 2024).

pmc-13591056.creator: Ethan M Laumer, Sophie M Neu, Benjamin C Klementz, Pranil Panda, Emily V W Setton, Prashant P Sharma, Ilya Ruvinsky
pmc-13591056.description: The evolution of visual systems has compelled numerous investigations of developmental processes underlying eye patterning across Bilateria.
